in_marathi.name: Akaayla
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moonlight, radiant one
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akaayla हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Akaayla is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Akas' meaning sky and 'Kal' meaning night or time. Akaayla represents the radiance of the moon in the sky at night, reflecting the light of the heavens and inspiring awe and wonder.
